rows.grounds: dehādanyatra = elsewhere-than-the-body; dehāt (abl.sg of deha) + anyatra (indeclinable)
yattejastadadhiṣṭhāturātmanaḥ = of-the-self presiding-over that light; yat (n.nom.sg) + tejas (n.nom.sg) + tad (n.nom.sg) + adhiṣṭhātuḥ (m.gen.sg of adhiṣṭhātṛ) + ātmanaḥ (m.gen.sg of ātman)
tenaiva = by-that-very; tena (n.ins.sg of tad) + eva (indeclinable emphatic particle)
tejasā = by-light; instrumental singular of tejas
jñatve = in-knowing; absolutive/gerund of √jñā (surface form jñatve/jñatvā variant)
ko@rthaḥ = what-purpose; kaḥ (m.nom.sg of kim) + arthaḥ (m.nom.sg of artha)
syāddarpaṇena = would-there-be with-mirror; syāt (3sg.opt.act √as) + darpaṇena (m.ins.sg of darpaṇa)
